title: 将来决定、计划和已安排活动

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct will form: I ____ carry the boxes.
questions.evidence: will 后接动词原形，可表达临时决定、承诺或预测；不同将来结构可能在语境中都可用，不能仅凭一个时间词判断唯一形式。
questions.explanation: will 后接动词原形 carry；不能加 to、人称词尾或直接加 carrying。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using will.
options: The organizer will send the invitation.
The organizer will sends the invitation.
The organizer will to send the invitation.
The organizer wills send the invitation.
answers: The organizer will send the invitation.
questions.evidence: will 后接动词原形，可表达临时决定、承诺或预测；不同将来结构可能在语境中都可用，不能仅凭一个时间词判断唯一形式。
questions.explanation: will 不随主语加词尾，其后用 send 原形；其余选项重复变化或误加 to。

questions.prompt: After an unexpected request, choose a correct offer with will.
options: I will to prepare a leaflet.
questions.evidence: will 后接动词原形，可表达临时决定、承诺或预测；不同将来结构可能在语境中都可用，不能仅凭一个时间词判断唯一形式。
questions.explanation: will 可用于当场提出帮助，后接 prepare 原形；其他动词形式不合。

questions.prompt: The group ____ ask for confirmation tomorrow.
questions.evidence: will 后接动词原形，可表达临时决定、承诺或预测；不同将来结构可能在语境中都可用，不能仅凭一个时间词判断唯一形式。
questions.explanation: will 后直接接原形 ask；时间词不会单独证明其他将来形式都错误。

questions.prompt: Complete the existing plan using going to: Priya ____ going to check the calendar.
questions.evidence: be going to 后接动词原形，可表达已有计划或根据当前迹象作出的预测；be 随主语变化，不要遗漏或重复 to。
questions.explanation: 单数 Priya 搭配 is going to；are 和 am 与主语不一致，be 不能直接这样使用。

questions.prompt: Complete the existing plan: We are going to ____ the prototype.
questions.evidence: be going to 后接动词原形，可表达已有计划或根据当前迹象作出的预测；be 随主语变化，不要遗漏或重复 to。
questions.explanation: going to 后接动词原形 revise；其他时态或分词不合该结构。

options: They are going to prepare a brochure.
They is going to prepare a brochure.
They are going prepare a brochure.
They are going to prepares a brochure.
answers: They are going to prepare a brochure.
questions.evidence: be going to 后接动词原形，可表达已有计划或根据当前迹象作出的预测；be 随主语变化，不要遗漏或重复 to。
questions.explanation: 复数 they 用 are going to prepare；不能省略 to 或给 prepare 加词尾。

questions.prompt: Complete the planned action: I ____ going to draw a label.
questions.evidence: be going to 后接动词原形，可表达已有计划或根据当前迹象作出的预测；be 随主语变化，不要遗漏或重复 to。
questions.explanation: 主语 I 搭配 am going to；is、are 与 I 不一致，额外的 to 使结构错误。

questions.prompt: Use the present continuous for the arranged appointment: They ____ at the library at three tomorrow.
questions.evidence: 现在进行时也可表示已经安排好的将来活动，结构是 am / is / are 加动词 ing；具体时间和安排可帮助读者理解。
questions.explanation: 复数 they 用 are meeting 表已安排活动；is 与主语不符，其他形式缺正确 be 或 ing。

questions.prompt: Use the present continuous for the arranged visit: The tutor ____ the group on Monday.
questions.evidence: 现在进行时也可表示已经安排好的将来活动，结构是 am / is / are 加动词 ing；具体时间和安排可帮助读者理解。
questions.explanation: 单数 tutor 用 is visiting；are 与主语不符，visit 或 visiting 单独使用结构不完整。

questions.prompt: Choose the present continuous sentence describing an arranged meeting.
options: We is meeting the guide on Tuesday.
We are meet the guide on Tuesday.
We are meeting the guide on Tuesday.
We meeting the guide on Tuesday.
answers: We are meeting the guide on Tuesday.
questions.evidence: 现在进行时也可表示已经安排好的将来活动，结构是 am / is / are 加动词 ing；具体时间和安排可帮助读者理解。
questions.explanation: we 使用 are meeting；is 不一致，meet 无 ing，最后一项缺助动词。

questions.prompt: Use the present continuous for the arranged activity: I ____ the room at ten tomorrow.
questions.evidence: 现在进行时也可表示已经安排好的将来活动，结构是 am / is / are 加动词 ing；具体时间和安排可帮助读者理解。
questions.explanation: I 搭配 am checking；is 不与 I 搭配，动词需 ing，最后一项缺 am。

instructions: Read the Chinese explanations; the last four questions transfer the rule to new situations.
passage:
1. will 后接动词原形，可表达临时决定、承诺或预测；不同将来结构可能在语境中都可用，不能仅凭一个时间词判断唯一形式。
例句：I will help with the cards. They will ask the manager.

2. be going to 后接动词原形，可表达已有计划或根据当前迹象作出的预测；be 随主语变化，不要遗漏或重复 to。
例句：She is going to prepare a card. They are going to visit the room.

3. 现在进行时也可表示已经安排好的将来活动，结构是 am / is / are 加动词 ing；具体时间和安排可帮助读者理解。
例句：The visitors are meeting at noon tomorrow. Ava is visiting the office on Friday.
